description: This file defines a mock implementation of a cache service used in unit testing within the OrangeHRM project. It extends the CacheService class and provides a static method to retrieve an in-memory cache adapter.

classes.name: MockCacheService
classes.description: A mock class for cache service used primarily in unit tests, extending the core CacheService, providing a static method to obtain a cache adapter.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ArrayAdapter, providing an in-memory cache suitable for testing scenarios.
